# Container

Containers can be used as main layout with fluid or fixed width.<br />
It implements breakpoints and content area rules.

See [Grid and Layout guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/visual-styles/grid/)<br />
See the supported <LinkTo kind="General/Layout/Introduction" story="docs">breakpoints</LinkTo>

Note: the examples below are best experienced in a separate window.

<Primary />

The default `ds-container` is fluid: it sets a `width: 100%` at all breakpoints.<br />
With the breakpoints modifiers `ds-container--until-{breakpoint}`, you can have a fluid container until a specific breakpoint.

If you prefer to design for a fixed set of sizes instead of a fully fluid viewport, you can use the `ds-container-fixed`.<br />
The `max-width` of this container will match the current breakpoint content area.

<Canvas of={ContainerStories.Examples} />

```css
.bg-warmgrey-20 {
  background-color: #f0f4f6;
}
.p-1 {
  padding: 1rem;
}
```
